pattern: と言ってもいい（といってもいい）
purpose: Say that a description is a reasonable characterization.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + と言ってもいい.
It would be fair to say this work was a success.
You could call him a representative of this town.
I could call this my second hometown.
formation: Plain clause + と言ってもいい.
restrictions: Allows an approximate or defensible description rather than asserting literal identity.
mistake: The phrase concerns how something may be described, not physical permission to speak.
